name: Dal Lake
description: Srinagar's floating heart: carved cedar houseboats moored along still water, shikara rides at first light, and snow peaks mirrored in the lake. Wander the floating vegetable market before the day warms up.

name: Gulmarg
description: A high-altitude meadow ringed by pine forest. Wildflowers in summer, deep snow and skiing in winter, and a gondola that climbs above the tree line.
bestSeason: Dec to Mar, Jun to Aug

name: Pahalgam
description: A river-cut valley of meadows and pine, and the base for treks and day trips. The Lidder River runs clear right through the town.

name: Sonamarg
description: A broad Himalayan valley surrounded by glaciers and snow peaks, and the gateway to high-altitude lakes. The Sindh River flows beside the main meadow.

name: Gurez Valley
description: A remote valley along the Kishanganga River, with traditional wooden villages and a slow pace. Reaching it is part of the journey.

name: Yusmarg
description: A quiet pine-fringed meadow, calmer than the bigger hill stations. Good for easy walks and a long picnic.

name: Doodhpathri
description: A grassy bowl with a stream running through it, named for its milk-white water. A short drive from Srinagar and ideal for a day trip.

name: Mughal Gardens
description: Terraced gardens built by the Mughals along the Dal Lake shoreline. Chinar trees, fountains and long views across the water.
